closed note 4894149 (near Országút, 2nd district) / Created 3 days ago by Ramanujan23
"Il manque le nom de la station de métro : Széll Kálmán tér." OSM snapshot date: 2025-07-08T15:45:36Z POI has no name POI types: wheelchair-no railway-subway_entrance-budapest #organicmaps android / Resolved 1 day ago by infeeeee
Wiki says name of subway entrances shouldn't duplicate the name of the station, renderers should get the name of the entrance from the stop area relation. https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:railway%3Dsubway_entrance The stop area is mapped and tagged correctly: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/562651 So this is an issue in Organic Maps not in osm data, you should raise the issue there: https://github.com/organicmaps/organicmaps/issues
